notes: A self-contained WebGL city with deterministic streamed building chunks, continuous street grid, authored beacon landmarks, walk/drive/flight modes, building collision, wandering inhabitants with proximity reactions, seven collectible memory echoes, live map, journal, guarded local save/load, day cycle, smoothly transitioning weather, rain, distance fog, emissive lighting, synthesized hum and discovery tones, and adaptive pixel-density/rain quality. No external assets, libraries, build step or network dependency. NPCs use roaming routines rather than full pathfinding; audio is a simple synthesized ambience/chime layer rather than positional biome audio. Browser rendering could not be verified because headless Chromium failed to initialize its graphics/display backend in this environment. JavaScript syntax, metadata JSON, entry-file existence and duplicate HTML IDs passed code-level smoke checks. WebGL support is required.
